title: Fail closed WebBurner package selection and reconcile current-state documentation

firmware.reason: The change validates static package-selection policy with local synthetic fixtures.

checks.name: archive_path_policy
checks.detail: NFC/POSIX normalization rejects absolute paths, backslashes, control characters, dot segments, reserved/non-portable names, casefold and parent-child collisions, and symlinks.

checks.name: resource_uniqueness
checks.detail: Ambiguous WebBurner manifest, flasher, eFuse, ELF/MAP and SBOM resources fail closed instead of selecting the first sorted path.

checks.name: sdkconfig_precedence
checks.detail: Each sdkconfig candidate class must be unique; an effective sdkconfig is selected explicitly over sdkconfig.defaults.

checks.name: multi_build_soc_selection
checks.detail: A multi-build package requires a target device and exactly one matching SoC build.

checks.name: boolean_offset_rejection
checks.detail: JSON true/false offsets are rejected instead of being accepted through Python's bool/int subtype relationship.

checks.name: historical_sample_baseline_label
checks.detail: The generated snapshot marks the 21 public samples as a dated hash-bound baseline rather than implicitly current total coverage.

checks.name: firmware_runtime
checks.detail: No public firmware package was re-imported through a live flash/boot path in this change.

notes: This is static import-policy and documentation-contract validation, not firmware runtime or hardware validation.
The 21-sample public set remains a historical hash-bound baseline; later evidence is not folded into that count implicitly.
No credentials, device identifiers, private endpoints, firmware binaries or keys were added.
